item.title: Over 42,000 youth Receive Stipends as TVET initiative rolls out nationwide
item.description: Nigeria's education sector celebrates a milestone with the rollout of the TVET Initiative, providing N22,500 stipends to over 42,000 beneficiaries.

item.title: Popular security firm disengages former staff, details emerge
item.description: Tantita Security Services Nigeria Limited, Ondo State Operations, has sacked a former staff members, Mr. Owoyele Omotuyi Joseph, over alleged misconduct.

item.title: Read trending post as lady who stayed with Aunty Esther gives detailed account of what she witnessed
item.description: A trending post making the rounds on social media has captured the moment a Nigerian lady shared her experience with Aunty Esther, a personal shopper.

item.title: Read trending tweet as man shares experience after visiting Aunty Esther at hospital
item.description: A Nigerian man who visited Aunty Esther at the hospital has cried out online while sharing what he witnessed. Netizens reacted massively to the post.

item.title: Photo: See the quit notice a lady got from her landlady
item.description: A lady said her landlady issued her a quit notice which she did not expect. According to the lady, she was preparing to renew her rent when the notice came.

item.title: Photo: See how this lady knelt to collect ring from her man
item.description: A Nigerian lady who knelt down to collect engagement ring from her man has gone viral on social media. According to the lady, the man dated her for 9 years.

item.title: Photo: See the throwback photo that is trending online, you will be amazed
item.description: A Nigerian lady shared photos to celebrate her graduation from the University of Benin, Edo state. The two photos she posted made a lot of people emotional.

item.title: First thing General Musa did on resuming office as Defence Minister
item.description: General Christopher Musa has taken the first step as he formally resumed office as the Minister of Defence. His first action in office has been captured in a video.

item.title: Eric Chelle defends decision to include injured players in Super Eagles preliminary 2025 AFCON squad
item.description: Super Eagles coach Eric Chelle has defended his decision to include injured players like Ola Aina and Felix Agu in the preliminary 54-man squad for the 2025 AFCON.

item.title: Opinion: Starving the mindset that feeds terrorism, by Timi Olagunju
item.description: In Nigeria, violence thrives on false ideologies; governance strategist Timi Olagunju explains how moral clarity and reclaimed narratives can stop terrorism.
